layout: 3 columns by 2 rows; top: miso, shiitake, yeast; bottom: oats, tea, crackers
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a single 3-by-2 product-photo texture atlas for a compact mobile pantry marketplace prototype. Generate one landscape 3:2 image divided into SIX EXACTLY EQUAL SQUARE CELLS, no borders or gutters. Each cell is an independent photorealistic ecommerce packshot centered with generous breathing room on the same warm pale off-white tabletop, soft daylight and subtle real shadows. Top row left to right: (1) a sealed clear squat jar of white miso with minimalist cream and sage green label, (2) a sealed kraft pouch of dried shiitake mushrooms with small clear window and forest green label, (3) a sealed amber jar of golden nutritional yeast flakes with cream label and muted saffron accent. Bottom row left to right: (4) a cream cardboard box of rolled oats with natural beige label, (5) a sealed sage-green carton of jasmine green tea, (6) a sealed cream pouch of sesame crackers with a coral accent and clear window. No real brands, no logos, no people, no promotional text, no dietary certification icons or certification claims, no expiry dates. Only short generic product names in tiny unobtrusive English on the packaging. Entire package fully inside its cell, product occupies about 65 percent of cell height. Consistent elegant editorial product photography, tactile paper, glass and packaging, natural neutral palette. These are fictional sample products, not evidence of real products or ingredient labels.
restrictions: Preview artwork only. Not real merchandise or ingredient/seal/date evidence. Never satisfies publication-photo validation.
